'''Var Narek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. His [[Var Narek's father|father's]] anger toward the planet's [[Planetary Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Ellor Orgraal]], rubbed off on him, and extended to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a whole.<ref name="OAA" />

Narek eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces at [[Arda Base]], where he became a [[field assistant]] to [[Setenna Hase]], one of the founders of the Arda cell. He achieved the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. However, after his brother [[Aleos Narek|Aleos]] and his family were killed during a battle between Rebel and Imperial forces, Narek decided that he had to end the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], even if that meant an Imperial victory.<ref name="OAA" />

Narek contacted a [[Malau Jocaos|member]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] service and provided him with the location of the Arda base. When Imperial forces drove the rebels off of [[Arda I]], Narek traveled with the survivors to [[Jagomir]], where his actions were discovered. Before he could be apprehended, though, Narek was able to escape, [[Kidnapping of Setenna Hase|taking Hase prisoner]]. He then fled to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="OAA" />
